\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 210-213 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:AR-R218-first-pass-words-from-chapters-210-213}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a piece and weight.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item direct, generous, mean, shy, sociable
  \item sunny, different, similar, rare, ordinary
  \item rough, sticky, fragile, transparent, shiny
  \item a sofa, a brush, a lid, furniture, laundry
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Direct? (\textbf{\ar{مباشر}}, \emph{mubāshir}.) Generous? (\textbf{\ar{كريم}}, \emph{karīm}.) Mean? (\textbf{\ar{بخيل}}, \emph{bakhīl}.) Shy? (\textbf{\ar{خجول}}, \emph{khajūl}.) Sociable? (\textbf{\ar{اجتماعي}}, \emph{ijtimāʿī}.) Sunny? (\textbf{\ar{مشمس}}, \emph{mushmis}.) Different? (\textbf{\ar{مختلف}}, \emph{mukhtalif}.) Similar? (\textbf{\ar{مشابه}}, \emph{mushābih}.) Rare? (\textbf{\ar{نادر}}, \emph{nādir}.) Ordinary? (\textbf{\ar{عادي}}, \emph{ʿādī}.) Rough? (\textbf{\ar{خشن}}, \emph{khashin}.) Sticky? (\textbf{\ar{لزج}}, \emph{lazij}.) Fragile? (\textbf{\ar{هش}}, \emph{hashsh}.) Transparent? (\textbf{\ar{شفاف}}, \emph{shaffāf}.) Shiny? (\textbf{\ar{لامع}}, \emph{lāmiʿ}.) A sofa? (\textbf{\ar{أريكة}}, \emph{arīka}.) A brush? (\textbf{\ar{فرشاة}}, \emph{furshā}.) A lid? (\textbf{\ar{غطاء}}, \emph{ghiṭāʾ}.) Furniture? (\textbf{\ar{أثاث}}, \emph{athāth}.) Laundry? (\textbf{\ar{غسيل}}, \emph{ghasīl}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 214-218 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:AR-R218-second-pass-words-from-chapters-214-218}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a suit and sandals.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a suit, sandals, fabric, cotton, wool
  \item an identity card, a visa, luggage, a charger, a taxi
  \item a poem, a conversation, a secret, a promise, fog
  \item a tail, a wing, a camera, headphones, a battery
  \item a hammer, a topic, scales, a piece, weight
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A suit? (\textbf{\ar{بدلة}}, \emph{badla}.) Sandals? (\textbf{\ar{صندل}}, \emph{ṣandal}.) Fabric? (\textbf{\ar{قماش}}, \emph{qumāsh}.) Cotton? (\textbf{\ar{قطن}}, \emph{quṭn}.) Wool? (\textbf{\ar{صوف}}, \emph{ṣūf}.) An identity card? (\textbf{\ar{هوية}}, \emph{hawiyya}.) A visa? (\textbf{\ar{تأشيرة}}, \emph{taʾshīra}.) Luggage? (\textbf{\ar{أمتعة}}, \emph{amtiʿa}.) A charger? (\textbf{\ar{شاحن}}, \emph{shāḥin}.) A taxi? (\textbf{\ar{تاكسي}}, \emph{tāksī}.) A poem? (\textbf{\ar{قصيدة}}, \emph{qaṣīda}.) A conversation? (\textbf{\ar{حديث}}, \emph{ḥadīth}.) A secret? (\textbf{\ar{سر}}, \emph{sirr}.) A promise? (\textbf{\ar{وعد}}, \emph{waʿd}.) Fog? (\textbf{\ar{ضباب}}, \emph{ḍabāb}.) A tail? (\textbf{\ar{ذيل}}, \emph{dhayl}.) A wing? (\textbf{\ar{جناح}}, \emph{janāḥ}.) A camera? (\textbf{\ar{كاميرا}}, \emph{kāmīrā}.) Headphones? (\textbf{\ar{سماعة}}, \emph{sammāʿa}.) A battery? (\textbf{\ar{بطارية}}, \emph{baṭṭāriyya}.) A hammer? (\textbf{\ar{مطرقة}}, \emph{miṭraqa}.) A topic? (\textbf{\ar{موضوع}}, \emph{mawḍūʿ}.) Scales? (\textbf{\ar{ميزان}}, \emph{mīzān}.) A piece? (\textbf{\ar{قطعة}}, \emph{qiṭʿa}.) Weight? (\textbf{\ar{وزن}}, \emph{wazn}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
